summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_secret and client_id; sources login/extra.client_id and password/extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var references for both secrets). Registered it in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py directly after the token mapping and added it to the export lists in the databricks and profiles packages. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, auth/secret override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run and no repository code was executed, per instructions. No commit was made.
